title: Divider 区切り線
description: コンテンツを水平または垂直に区切る細い線。テキストを含めることもできます。

slots.name: default
slots.description: Optional text of a horizontal divider (ignored when vertical)

wc:minerva-divider.description: A horizontal or vertical separator line (`<Divider>` of React). Without content it renders a native `<hr>` (implicit `separator` role); text in the default slot is rendered between the two halves of a horizontal divider (`role="separator"`). The line color comes from `--divider-color`. Vertical dividers are inline (1em high); `flex-item` stretches one to the height of its flex container.

properties.name: length
properties.description: Length of the line (width when horizontal, height when vertical): px number or CSS length

properties.name: spacing
properties.description: Margin around the divider in pixels (block axis when horizontal, inline axis when vertical)

properties.name: flexItem
properties.description: Vertical divider stretching to the height of its flex container

slots.description: Optional text of a horizontal divider (ignored when vertical)

parts.name: root
parts.description: The <hr>, or the role=separator element of a divider with text (align: position of the text)

parts.name: label
parts.description: The text between the two halves of the line

cssProperties.name: --divider-spacing
cssProperties.description: Inline margin around a vertical divider

cssProperties.name: --divider-text-gap
cssProperties.description: Space between the text and the lines

vars.name: --divider-spacing
vars.description: Inline margin around a vertical divider

vars.name: --divider-text-gap
vars.description: Space between the text and the lines
